verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly describe diff inspection and pre-merge checks: 'Inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge' (cursor-docs-4), backed by Bugbot's automated PR review for bugs/security/quality issues (cursor-supp-bugbot), Run Modes with sandboxing and classifier review before applying changes (cursor-supp-run-modes), and hooks that can gate risky operations or scan for secrets pre-merge (cursor-supp-hooks). CI integration via Cursor CLI in GitHub Actions further supports running checks before merge (cursor-supp-cli-github-actions). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of diff review accuracy and no first-party demo of the actual diff UI workflow beyond docs summaries.
